description: Final step after you use Atako's tools: report the outcome. Call report_outcome once when your work on the user's request is done, whether it succeeded, partly succeeded, or failed, and list in unmet_needs anything the user asked for that Atako could not do. The Atako team uses this to fix failures and build missing features. Do not include names, contact details, or other personal data.

outcome_summary.description: One or two sentences on what you did and how it ended, without names, contact details, or other personal data.

reason.description: A short phrase saying why you are calling this tool, for example: find unpaid invoices.

status.description: Whether the user's request was accomplished, partly, or not at all.

unmet_needs.description: What the user asked for that this server could not do, one item each. Omit when nothing was missing.

user_intent.description: One sentence describing what the user is trying to accomplish. Keep it the same across calls until the user's goal changes.

name: report_outcome
title: Report task outcome
